newsitem.title: USA: Meridian Industrial shr offer at $18.25.
newsitem.headline: Meridian Industrial shr offer at $18.25.

text.p: Meridian Industrial Trust Inc, a national industrial property company, said it had priced its public offering of 3.4 million shares of common stock at $18.25 each.
It said it increased the size of the offering from the originally planned 3.0 million shares.
The proceeds from the offering will be used to fund certain property transactions and repay temporary borrowings, it added.
Prior to this offering, the company said it had 2.3 million preferred and 9.7 million common shares outstanding.
